verdict.rationale: Analytical query performance is a fair question for any database, so the axis applies. The pack offers no evidence that Turso handles heavy aggregations over large tables at dashboard speed: there is no mention of columnar storage, OLAP features, parallel query execution or analytical benchmarks. The docs position Turso as a small, embedded, per-tenant SQLite-compatible database, and community reports point the other way, noting missing window functions and failures on deeply nested joins.
